text:
Hello, everybody! 😊

Just wanted to share some good news! Today, we had our interview for our A5 visa renewal in Ashkelon. Surprisingly, the clerk was already aware of the recent procedure, and we were issued a 2-year visa, together with my daughter. As what she said, some get it, some no.🥲

We would like to extend our warmest gratitude to everyone who made this possible—the moderators of this group for their prompt responses and guidance, our fellow international couples who generously shared their valuable insights and experiences, and Lior and everyone behind this effort for doing their best to fight for our rights.

We truly appreciate all your hard work, support, and dedication. It means so much to us and to many families in the same situation. ❤️ Thank you
